serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Given how Landlord’s daughter looks it should be easy to find her, even in this megacity.
You see a girl as flashy as her only once in a while. I’m sure she makes a huge impression on everyone she passes by.
That’s right! It would be a good idea to ask passersby about her. 
You: Excuse me, did you see that girl?
???1: What? Are you a cop?
You: N-No?
???1: That’s exactly what a cop would say! Fuck off!
People like this are also in this world, huh. Let’s try someone else.
You: Did you see that girl?
???2: Damn, boy. She’s gone. She belongs to the streets now, you are not getting her back.
You: No, it’s not like that. She’s a daughter of my acquaintance…
???2: My condolences to him, dog. I would rather want my daughter to be dead than to look like that. 
You: …
Maybe it wasn’t a good idea after all…
Sooner or later I will find her. Everyone these days walks in black or gray. Spotting her coat should be an easy task even in this crowd.
There she is!
That was quick. Her member-shaped blonde haircut is one of a kind.
You: Excuse me, could we talk for a little bit?
